settings.html:
<style>
.related-title-editorial {
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif !important;
    font-size: 36px !important;
    color: #0E1B30 !important;
    margin-bottom: 48px !important;
    font-weight: 400 !important;
    text-align: center !important;
}

.related-title-editorial .italic {
    font-style: italic !important;
    color: #688F9D !important;
}

/* Editorial Grid Styling */
.stillness-editorial-related-section .related.products ul.products,
.stillness-editorial-related-section .upsells.products ul.products {
    display: grid !important;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr) !important;
    gap: 40px !important;
    list-style: none !important;
    padding: 0 !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
}

@media (max-width: 1024px) {
    .stillness-editorial-related-section .related.products ul.products,
    .stillness-editorial-related-section .upsells.products ul.products {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr) !important;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 600px) {
    .stillness-editorial-related-section .related.products ul.products,
    .stillness-editorial-related-section .upsells.products ul.products {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr !important;
    }
}

.stillness-editorial-related-section li.product {
    background: none !important;
    padding: 0 !important;
    border: none !important;
    width: 100% !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
    text-align: center !important;
    display: flex !important;
    flex-direction: column !important;
    align-items: center !important;
}

.stillness-editorial-related-section li.product:hover img {
    transform: translateY(-8px) scale(1.02) !important;
}

.stillness-editorial-related-section li.product img {
    border-radius: 8px !important;
    margin-bottom: 20px !important;
    width: 100% !important;
    aspect-ratio: 0.75 !important; /* Portrait Rectangle */
    object-fit: cover !important;
    transition: all 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1) !important;
    box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(14,27,48,0.03) !important;
}

.stillness-editorial-related-section li.product h2 {
    font-family: 'Lato', sans-serif !important;
    font-size: 13px !important;
    font-weight: 700 !important;
    text-transform: uppercase !important;
    letter-spacing: 2px !important;
    color: #0E1B30 !important;
    margin: 0 0 8px !important;
    line-height: 1.4 !important;
}

.stillness-editorial-related-section li.product .price {
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif !important;
    font-style: italic !important;
    font-size: 18px !important;
    color: #688F9D !important;
    display: block !important;
    margin-bottom: 12px !important;
}

.stillness-editorial-related-section li.product .button {
    margin-top: auto !important;
    background: transparent !important;
    border: 1px solid rgba(104,143,157,0.3) !important;
    color: #688F9D !important;
    border-radius: 100px !important;
    font-family: 'Lato', sans-serif !important;
    font-size: 10px !important;
    text-transform: uppercase !important;
    letter-spacing: 2px !important;
    padding: 10px 24px !important;
    display: inline-block !important;
    transition: all 0.3s ease !important;
}

.stillness-editorial-related-section li.product .button:hover {
    background: #0E1B30 !important;
    border-color: #0E1B30 !important;
    color: #FFFFFF !important;
    transform: translateY(-3px) !important;
}

.stillness-editorial-related-section .woocommerce-loop-product__link {
    display: block !important;
    text-decoration: none !important;
    width: 100% !important;
}
</style>
